title: Cocoon Nave
shortDescription: A stone nave hung with cocoons, and one husk already torn open.
longDescription:
The nave is an oval of old stone and hanging silk. Larger cocoons hang unopened. One husk has already split. The air tastes of dust and sweet glue.
A silk-hatchling is here if it still lives. It is not the queen. It woke too early, and Piper wants it finished.

fixtures.name: Waking Husk
fixtures.examineDescription: The opened husk is lined with warm thread. Something satchel-sized slept here and left too soon. Larger closed cocoons hang beyond it, still shut. This is the first waking, not the last. Alder asked you to name it before anyone calls it a queen.
